$comment: What tools/rebrand/rename.py does on top of the 'auto' rules of policy.json. policy.json stays the single source for names and variables (MODULE_ROOT lives only there). Anything here is mechanical and compile-checked; nothing here may touch a wire or data surface: those are listed in legacy-allow.txt and are claimed before any rule runs.

promote.why: The Go package and its directory are renamed in this pass (git mv), so every import must follow in the same step or nothing compiles. The frozen fixtures (testdata/sdk-1.*) and the fixture plugin that is built against them keep the old directory name.
Locale keys are the English text. They are rewritten as JSON (keys and values, every locale) in the same run as the HTML/JS text, and key collisions are reported.

extra_rules.notes: The module path in files the policy rule module-path does not list (.txt, .yml, .py, .html docs). Same replacement, same variable.
Example plugins used upstream's domain as their Go module root. A module path is compile-time only.
Same variables as policy rule env-test-vars, in the docs and non-test files that mention them.

Zoraxy inside identifiers and names (ZoraxyPort, IsZoraxyName, nginxToZoraxy, 'What%20is%20Zoraxy%20Plugin'), and the prose of the SDK package that the policy's text rule skips. Struct fields keep their json tags, so no wire name changes.
Local names such as the zoraxyPlugin import alias. zoraxyVersion and zoraxyI18n are data fields and are in legacy-allow.txt.
Shell and Python function names in tools/, docker/entrypoint.py and their docs.
Local variables, the docker build stage name, the traceroute probe payload (plan row 46: R) and a test-only gauge.
Placeholders in docs and tool help.
Element id of the About block; the ui-smoke selector follows.
Links to docs/nginx2zoraxy.html, which is renamed by this pass. Links to the copy on upstream's site are claimed by legacy-allow.txt and stay.

name_renames_notes: docs/deploy/zoraxy.service is NOT renamed here: the plan (row 38) keeps it as the legacy unit and WP8 adds dunree.service next to it.
extra_exclude_notes: .gitignore keeps the old build-output names next to the new ones (edited by hand). README, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, CODEOWNERS, ROADMAP, docs/README.md and docs/roadmap-history.md were written by hand for Dunree and name Zoraxy on purpose (what Dunree is based on, where not to report, history). src/web/legal/** are byte copies of LICENSE, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (TestLegalFilesShippedWithUI). supporters.txt lists the supporters of Zoraxy. src/mod/brand, src/brandweb_test.go and tools/ui-smoke/brand_smoke.py hold and test the attribution. docs/legal/** are byte copies of LICENSE, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the documentation index; docs/index.html is written by tools/docs/build_index.py and names Zoraxy as what Dunree is based on; tools/docs/test_docs.py asserts that text, the kept container label and the old container paths.
